name: obsidian-solution-designer
description: Use for implementation-ready backend or full-stack detailed designs for concrete software requirements, grounded in verified system facts; not for general Obsidian notes, summaries, retrospectives, meeting minutes, or research documents.

interface.displayName: 需求驱动详细方案设计
interface.shortDescription: 为待实现的软件需求生成可指导开发的后端或全栈详细设计。
interface.longDescription: Use for concrete software requirements that need an implementation-ready backend or full-stack design grounded in repositories, databases, middleware, and source documents. Obsidian is only the delivery format; general notes, summaries, retrospectives, meeting minutes, research reports, and documentation formatting are out of scope. Missing critical facts stop document generation instead of producing low-value drafts.
defaultPrompt: Create an implementation-ready backend detailed design for this pending software requirement using the provided repository facts.
Create an implementation-ready full-stack design for this pending feature with closed frontend and backend interactions.
Update the existing backend or full-stack detailed design for this software change after re-verifying its implementation sources.
